problem_statement: The PSA Crypto hash API must support the SHA-3 family of hash algorithms. Calling psa_hash_compare() with the algorithm identifiers PSA_ALG_SHA3_256, PSA_ALG_SHA3_384, or PSA_ALG_SHA3_512 must produce the correct SHA-3 digest for the given input, just as it already does for the SHA-2 family. Today these algorithms are not handled by the PSA Crypto layer and the call cannot succeed. The implementation should route these algorithm requests to RIOT's existing SHA-3 hash implementation (available via the hashes module) so that setup, incremental update, and finish produce a correct hash of the appropriate output length (32, 48, and 64 bytes respectively).
